name: The Emerald Dreamcatcher
summary: In Dolanaar, Tallonkai Swiftroot asks you to recover a cherished heirloom from his abandoned home in Starbreeze Village. Gaerolas Talvethren, the druid warden, gave him the Emerald Dreamcatcher, which he left behind when corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs overran the settlement. Recovering it keeps its gentle nature magic from falling into foul hands.

sections.title: A Druidic Talisman
sections.body: Gaerolas Talvethren gave Tallonkai a rare druidic talisman. The warden watches over the sleeping druids within Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Crafted to channel the serene currents of the Emerald Dream, the amulet draws on that pure spiritual energy to bring peace and fortune to its bearer. Such gifts go only to a trusted few whose lives are bound to the forest's care.

sections.title: Fleeing Starbreeze Village
sections.body: Starbreeze Village was peaceful until the Gnarlpine furbolgs succumbed to violent madness. They drove the villagers from their ancestral homes. During the fearful flight, Tallonkai left his most treasured possession hidden inside his dresser in the village's southeastern quarter. He could not reclaim it on his own.

sections.title: The Threat of Corruption
sections.body: Leaving a focus of Emerald Dream magic in an overrun village carries grave risks. The Gnarlpine have fallen under dark influences, and the Dream's power in the amulet could be tainted or turned to harm. Returning the dreamcatcher to Tallonkai keeps its lingering magic from the furbolgs or other foul denizens. It also brings a piece of Starbreeze's heritage back to him.

faq.answer: The Emerald Dreamcatcher is a rare amulet Gaerolas Talvethren gave to Tallonkai. The warden tends the sleeping druids in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The dreamcatcher draws energy from the Emerald Dream to bring good fortune and spiritual harmony to its bearer.

faq.q: Why was the dreamcatcher left behind in Starbreeze Village?
faq.answer: The local Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Starbreeze Village in a violent, corrupted frenzy. Tallonkai Swiftroot fled for his life to Dolanaar, leaving the heirloom hidden in his bedroom dresser.

Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf refugee staying in Dolanaar. He escaped the fall of Starbreeze Village and seeks brave travelers to enter the occupied ruins and recover his family heirlooms and druidic relics.
Tallonkai says Gaerolas Talvethren gave him the dreamcatcher. Gaerolas watches over the sleeping druids in Ban'ethil Barrow Den, but who made the amulet is never said.

faq.q: Where in Starbreeze Village is the dreamcatcher located?
faq.answer: The dreamcatcher rests in Tallonkai's dresser, inside the far southeastern house in Starbreeze Village. Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs now prowl the house heavily.

faq.q: What happens after the dreamcatcher is returned?
faq.answer: After Tallonkai inspects the recovered amulet, he discovers its emerald is missing. Ferocitas the Dream Eater, leader of the Gnarlpine, stole it, setting the hunt for him in motion.

angles.text: As a druid, you know Gaerolas Talvethren as the warden tending to your sleeping kin in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The dreamcatcher he gave Tallonkai makes its recovery a matter of druidic honor.
Starbreeze was once a tranquil haven for your people. Helping Tallonkai recover his heritage strikes a small blow against the madness seizing Teldrassil's wildlife.
By aiding the displaced Kaldorei of Dolanaar, you help secure local stability as corruption spreads among Teldrassil's furbolg tribes.
